title: Sobriety of a quasi-separated algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with point topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Assume its diagonal $X\to X\times_S X$ is quasi-compact on scheme tests, meaning that inverse images of quasi-compact opens are quasi-compact. Then $|X|$ is sober: every nonempty irreducible closed subset is the closure of exactly one point. Here irreducibility is [def-weil-irreducible-components].

source.place: Tag 03K6, proposition-reasonable-sober; quasi-separated implies decent by Tag 03JX, lemma-bounded-fibres, with definition-very-reasonable.

proof.text: Let $T\subseteq|X|$ be nonempty, irreducible and closed. By [lem-sfb-space-reduced-closed-support] choose its reduced closed subspace $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, whose point space is homeomorphic to $T$. The square of $\Delta_{Z/S}$ and $\Delta_{X/S}$ over $Z\times_S Z\to X\times_S X$ is cartesian: for each pair of $Z$-valued points their images in $X$ agree exactly when they agree, since $i$ is a subfunctor inclusion. Consequently every scheme test of $\Delta_{Z/S}$ is itself the test of $\Delta_{X/S}$ obtained by composing with $Z\times_S Z\to X\times_S X$. It is quasi-compact by the hypothesis on $X$. Thus $Z$ satisfies the relative diagonal condition.

source.place: Tag 03K6, proposition-reasonable-sober: passage to the reduced closed subspace; the monomorphism diagonal square replaces the general Tag 03KF inheritance statement.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-quasiseparated-space-dense-scheme-open] to $Z$. This gives a scheme $V$ whose point space is an open dense subset of $T$. It is nonempty, since $T$ is nonempty and it is dense. It is irreducible: two nonempty open subsets of $V$ are nonempty open subsets of $T$, so they meet by irreducibility of $T$. By [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-sober], applied to the whole space $|V|$ as a closed irreducible subset of itself, choose $\eta\in V$ whose closure in $V$ is all of $V$.

source.place: Tag 03K6, proposition-reasonable-sober: apply Tag 086U to the closed subspace, then Schemes Tag 01IS to its dense open scheme.

proof.text: View $\eta$ in $T\subseteq|X|$. Its closure $C$ in $|X|$ lies in $T$ because $T$ is closed. Since the subspace closure of $\{\eta\}$ in $V$ is $V$, we have $V\subseteq C$. The set $C$ is closed in $T$ and contains its dense subset $V$, so $C=T$. This proves existence of a generic point.

source.place: Tag 03K6, proposition-reasonable-sober: the final closure argument.

proof.text: For uniqueness, write $p\leadsto q$ for $q\in\overline{\{p\}}$. Suppose $x,y$ both have closure $T$, so $x\leadsto y$ and $y\leadsto x$. Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $a:U\to X$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]; since $a$ is representable and surjective on every scheme base change, $|a|$ is surjective [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus], so choose $u\in U$ above $y$. By [lem-sfb-quasiseparated-space-etale-specializations] lift $x\leadsto y$ to $v\leadsto u$ with $a(v)=x$, and then lift $y\leadsto x$ to $w\leadsto v$ with $a(w)=y$. Transitivity gives $w\leadsto u$, so the same cited lemma gives $w=u$. Thus $u\leadsto v$ and $v\leadsto u$. Their singleton closures in the scheme $U$ coincide; this closure is irreducible (any nonempty open subset of it contains its dense point). Scheme sobriety [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-sober] gives $u=v$, whence $y=x$.

source.place: Tag 03K3, lemma-kolmogorov, used at the start of Tag 03K6; specialization lifting and absence of fibre specializations are Tags 03IL and 03K5.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03K6, proposition-reasonable-sober, with the uniqueness proof of Tag 03K3, lemma-kolmogorov.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q16-3865a6f31 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read decent-spaces.tex 03JX (lemma-bounded-fibres), definition-very-reasonable, 086U (theorem-decent-open-dense-scheme), 03K5, 03IL, 03K3 (lemma-kolmogorov) and the full 03K6 proof (proposition-reasonable-sober). The tag labels were checked in tags/tags. The item statement is the same as in clones/live, where the item is still unsplit; there is no repair note. The item assumes only the relative diagonal over S. That is enough for decency: over each affine S' ⊆ S the absolute diagonal factors through the relative one and the closed immersion S' → S'×_Z S', so X is Zariski locally quasi-separated, and (ζ) gives decent. So 03K6 applies and the statement is true as written. Step 1: the reduced closed support node with q = id gives |Z| ≅ T. The cartesian square of diagonals is correct because i is a monomorphism, so Z has the relative quasi-compact diagonal. Step 2: the new node applied to Z, plus 01IS (Mathlib leaf); nonemptiness and irreducibility of V are argued correctly. Step 3: the closure argument is elementary and correct. Step 4: the specialization directions v⇝u, w⇝v, then w = u and u = v (by 01IS) were checked against the cited etale-specializations statement, which has the same hypothesis and any etale scheme-source map. C4 fault, repaired: the choice of a point u above y needs |a| surjective, but the step cited def-trf-algebraic-space-jointly-surjective-family, which only defines joint surjectivity on point classes. The FIX cites lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus instead (Stacks 03H5: a representable map surjective on every scheme base change is surjective on |·|; already widely cited in sec-six-functors-basics; no cycle) and records it in tool_uses. The FIX changes only step 4 uses and proof_deps. New node: statement only and self-contained. It is a correct specialization of 086U via 03JX (ζ), and the union of the open scheme pieces over affine opens of S is a dense open scheme. It is not a restatement of the item. rg -L found no duplicate (searched 086U, 03K6, 03K3, schematic locus, dense open subscheme/subspace, sober).
